text: The Facilities and Finance Nominating Panel will interview and recommend one public member to City Council for appointment to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee.

The Facilities and Finance Nominating Panel recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 26, 2021, and until a successor is appointed: - Marisha Roman 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (April 3, 3018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee.
